No funds, no writes. Contract: only getConfig leaves x-implementation planned (orchestrator commit after the contract slot freed); route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated, openapi.gen.ts unchanged. Rule test [AC-F1-02c#22] mechanically fixed by the orchestrator in the test(spec) commit 47508e4 (it deleted a config_items row through couli_app, which has no DELETE grant; it now seeds the app without kf; same assertion).
